answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the spiral funding graph is rebuilt from the ledge history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 294 bonds yet holds one position, and the ripple report publishes the merged exposure. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 294 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
